## %release_prefix% release info
- **YouTube Music version:** `%ytm_version%`
- **YTMusicUltimate:** `%ytmult_version%` 
## Must read:
- Releases named **YTMusicUltimate** are releases with only YTMusicUltimate tweak.
- Releases named **YTMUltimate+** have got YTMusicUltimate **but also the extra YTMUltimate+ tweaks** 
(Return-YouTube-Music-Dislikes, YTMABConfig, YouMusicPiP and VolumeBoostYT).
